method: Read-only inspection of final repository source and existing real-browser evidence; no tests rerun and no repository files changed.

findings.issue: Native range step could make an exact noncentisecond endpoint unreachable
findings.sourceResolution: range.step now divides the actual duration into 1000 intervals, preserving the exact max endpoint.

browserEvidence.check: Recorded real keyboard End reaches the exact fractional duration and keeps non-looping playback paused at the end.

findings.issue: Hiding the focused Pause/Resume button could interrupt keyboard continuation
findings.sourceResolution: refreshPreview transfers only the currently focused transport button; a same-owner resume-focus ticket handles disabled Resume blurring to body. Focus on the range or another editing control is not taken. stopPreview clears the ticket.

limits: Closure is limited to the two reviewed findings and the recorded local Chrome/source scope. It does not imply physical audio, Godot/Bevy, installation or mobile-device validation.
